scope: saved raw, accounting, separate arm invocation, frozen capture completeness and root cause only
stages_must_remain_distinct: 72 operational jobs comprises 48 normal arm jobs and 24 paid helper jobs; each helper job emits two arm observations.
Capture complete means source/display/usage structural binding, not independent semantic annotation complete or quality PASS.
Normal full-cohort F1 remains unavailable under the frozen completeness contract; no F1 was calculated by this reviewer.
Do not infer unsupported truth from intentionally empty acquired/admitted arrays in capture-failed observations; independent partial raw audits remain separate.

causes.details: Different resolver requests return the same complete immutable corpus record. Every record matches the reconstructed fixed-corpus record. Per-response duplicates and same-ID content conflicts observed: zero. Frozen capture rejects any previously seen ID before considering equality. Core records the later duplicate acquisition as malformed_output, admits no new IDs or facts, and keeps the original record exactly once in the final artifact.
causes.current_measurement_action: Preserve all 16 original incomplete observations; diagnostic acceptance is not observation repair.

causes.details: All 10 missing-journal events have empty IDs and fact keys, a declared capability and prior admitted ledger target. Their corresponding resolution round starts and ends Reject/resolved_refuted, has attempts=[], usage calls/attempts/tokens/time=0 and request_usage={}. Telemetry reports no_result, admitted0, verification_progress false; evidence records are unchanged from the preceding resolution. The common CLI emits evidence_admission unconditionally after core returns, while the common patched core retains its Reject short circuit before resolver execution. Frozen capture incorrectly requires a matching resolver journal even for such no-credit events.

arm_and_provider_evidence.interpretation: Google equality is consistent with separate seeded requests through the same frozen CLI and provider implementation. Source has direct per-generation HTTP dispatch and no saved-response reuse path. Binary hashes, arm argv, distinct processes, timing and wire journals support separate arm executions. Matching outputs do not demonstrate an ordinary feature effect.
arm_and_provider_evidence.limits: The journal stores normalized responses and allowlisted rate headers, not remote request IDs or raw provider billing receipts. It cannot independently prove remote billing or guarantee provider determinism. Whole-account quota headroom remains UNKNOWN; no adoption GO.

future_only_safe_boundary: Allow a same-ID record across distinct request IDs only when every occurrence equals the immutable expected record; reject duplicates within one response and any same-ID content collision.
Keep each request unique and each traced real acquisition bound to its planned target/question/key/capability, scope, authority, source bytes and admission sequence.
Allow a missing-resolver trace event only as no acquisition credit: declared capability, planned admitted-ledger target, prior-plan and terminal order, IDs=[] and fact_keys=[].

A skipped event must never add evidence, facts, source routes, citations or claim authority. Existing positive claims may use earlier independently validated admissions; final claims need not all be empty.
Keep global artifact/admission set equality, supported-claim and receipt guards, source deduplication and final acquisition-coverage outcomes unchanged.
Do not run the future binder into this experiment observations, semantic annotations or initial score.
